overall_summary: The performance data is extremely limited, with all initial videos receiving near-zero views (5-13 views). There is insufficient sample size to establish a definitive high-performing pattern, necessitating a controlled exploration strategy.

winning_patterns.evidence: Video uIbMpCjVutQ used a tangible item ('tea') and got initial traction alongside message/image hooks.
winning_patterns.action: Continue leveraging everyday physical objects or actions to anchor emotional states.

weak_patterns.pattern: Generic titles and broad emotional framing
weak_patterns.evidence: Videos with overly broad titles or captions like 'Bewafai Ka Dard' failed to trigger immediate engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Focus titles and hooks on hyper-specific, highly relatable micro-moments rather than generic emotional labels.

next_video.concept: Typing a long message to someone who left, then deleting it because sending it only gives them power.
next_video.opening_direction: Start with the sound or visual of fingers typing a very long paragraph late at night.
next_video.twist_direction: Instead of hitting send, the finger hits select all and backspace, realizing the peace of silence is worth more than their reply.
next_video.reason: Late evening hours align naturally with themes of overthinking and nighttime solitude.

experiment: Testing a high-friction digital habit (deleting an unsent draft message) combined with self-respect themes to see if action-oriented endings outperform passive sadness.
